digest.component_or_area: review-bot auto-deploy and code review voting
propositions: auto-deploy restarts review-bot container during in-flight code reviews, causing interrupted reviews to cast fail-closed LLM-Review -1 votes that block automatic recovery
shutdown drain timeout is set to 45 seconds but review timeout is 1200 seconds, causing drain to cancel workers mid-review and corrupt the review with a -1 vote
backfill reconciler treats fail-closed -1 votes as already-voted and skips re-drive, making the recovered change permanently invisible to retry
retryable failures (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should defer the vote and post nothing, allowing the reconciler to re-drive the change instead of fail-closing it
increase shutdown drain to 1200 seconds and stop_grace_period to 1320 seconds so quiesce waits for in-flight reviews to complete
implement bounded retry with escalation: after N consecutive retryable failures on the same revision, cast fail-closed -1 with retries-exhausted note and emit VOTER_ERROR alarm
